newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Genzyme starts as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Genzyme starts as buy.

text.p: -- Madison Securities Inc said Friday it initiated coverage of Genzyme Corp with a buy rating and a 12-18 month price target of $39 a share.

-- Madison said the biotechnology company's Cerezyme and Ceredase enzyme treatments, used to treat Gaucher disease, will continue to boost revenues and earnings. The approval of the Seprafilm and Sepracoat enzyme treatment in Europe should also drive topline growth in 1997 and 1998 with expected annual revenues of more than $300 million, Madison said. Seprafilm is used to prevent surgical adhesions.
-- Madison said Genzyme's business plan includes a diversified product line and a worldwide presence.
-- Genzyme shares closed up 1/2 Friday at 24-5/8.
